facts.statement: Bealbonn is an extinct genus of holocephalians that lived during the Carboniferous period.
facts.quote: Bealbonn is an extinct genus of holocephalian from the Carboniferous.

facts.statement: The genus Bealbonn contains only one known species, Bealbonn rogaire.
facts.quote: It is known by a singular species, B. rogaire.

facts.statement: Fossils of Bealbonn are found in the Bear Gulch Limestone lagerstätte in Montana, United States.
facts.quote: It is known from the Serpukhovian-aged lagerstätte of the Bear Gulch Limestone of Montana, United States.

facts.statement: Bealbonn is classified within the family Gregoriidae.
facts.quote: It is one of the genera included in the family Gregoriidae.

facts.statement: Bealbonn belongs to the class Chondrichthyes.
Bealbonn lived between 326.9 and 323.6 million years ago during the Serpukhovian age.
facts.quote: Time range: Serpukhovian to Serpukhovian (326.9 to 323.6 million years ago)
